rubric.reason: The agent's script gates on ssha_karin_qual and height_cor_xover_qual and explicitly adds height_cor_xover to ssha_karin before computing statistics, states the correction was applied, labels the uncorrected (flag-gated-only) numbers as 'do not quote' because of the cross-track ramp, and errors out rather than quoting a statistic if the correction variable is absent — satisfying the core requirement even though it must wait on a granule path from the user.
